text:
**My pick: the Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with a 200W panel.** It's the best balance of price, power, and track record for most people.

- **Price:** $699 on Amazon (list $879).
- **Specs:** 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery and 1,500W AC output, with about a 1-hour fast charge from a wall outlet.
- **Reviews:** 4.5 stars from 1.4K ratings, and it's labeled Amazon's "Overall Pick" in the results.
- **Real-world use:** One review site says it ran a full-size fridge for about 6 to 8 hours, and the 200W panel recharges it in roughly 6 to 8 hours of good sun.
- **Buy:** [Amazon results page](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**Other good options by need**

| Need | Pick | Price | Link |
|---|---|---|---|
| Similar size, strong alternative | EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic with 220W panel (1,024Wh, 1,800W, 4.6 stars) | $699 (list $1,099) | [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels) |
| Similar size, also $699 | BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 with 200W panel (1,024Wh, 4.5 stars) | $699 | [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels) |
| Home backup (fridge, longer outages) | Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with 2x200W panels (2,042Wh, 2,200W, 4.6 stars) | $1,399 | [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) |
| Bigger home backup | BLUETTI Elite 300 with 2x200W panels (3,014Wh, 4.7 stars) | $1,599.99 | [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels) |
| Tighter budget | UDPOWER S1200 with 120W panel (1,190Wh, 1,200W) | $549.99 | [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included) |
| Costco members | Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 with panel | $899.99 | [Costco](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html) |

**Things to know**
- **Budget pick:** The UDPOWER has only 41 ratings and a 4.1 average, so it's less proven than the Jackery, EcoFlow, and BLUETTI models.
- **Costco:** The Jackery 1500 v2 showed as out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse, though delivery was available.
- **Shipping:** One review site noted that some kits ship the panel and power station separately, so don't worry if they arrive in different boxes.
- **Prices:** These came from the search snapshots and can change, so check the final price at checkout.
- **ALLPOWERS P1800:** I left it out because the listing is for the power station alone, not a bundle with panels.

For a first solar generator, I'd start with the Jackery 1000 v2 bundle. If you need to run a fridge or other big appliances for days, step up to the Jackery 2000 v2 or BLUETTI Elite 300 kits.
